mapper.select: select * from dws_xc_transfer_accrue_natural_mouth_d where report_date like concat("%", #{month},"%") and is_delete = 0 order by report_date desc
select * from dws_xc_transfer_accrue_natural_mouth_call_d where report_date like concat("%", #{month},"%") and is_delete = 0 order by report_date desc
select * from dws_xc_transfer_seven_roll_d where report_date >= #{reportDateStart} and report_date <= #{reportDateEnd} and is_delete = 0
select * from dws_xc_collding_distrubute_day_d where report_date >= #{reportDateStart} and report_date <= #{reportDateEnd} and is_delete = 0

select count(DISTINCT datalog.cell_sha256_code_list) as count from ods_xc_colliding_log_half_hourly datalog inner join ods_upload_half_hourly upload on datalog.cell_sha256_code_list = upload.cell_sha256 where datalog.create_time >= #{reportDate} and datalog.create_time < #{reportDateEnd} and datalog.result = 1 and datalog.is_delete = 0 and upload.applet_date in ('2024-07-26', '2024-07-09', '2024-04-30', '2024-02-01', '2023-01-18', '2023-02-23', '2023-02-24', '2023-03-08', '2023-03-10', '2023-06-19', '2023-08-14') and upload.status = 1 and upload.is_repeat in (1, 2) and get_json_string(upload.reserve_field1, '$.dataPacket') in ('1400wdx', '1400wlt', '1200w', '2800w', '300w', '800w', '900w', '3300w', '3500w', '360w', '830w') and datalog.org_channel in ('CTRIP', 'QUNAR')
